title: The Lost Teddy Bear
description: Three short recordings about a lost teddy bear: a girl and her dad, the park keeper and two friends.
instructions: Read the questions for each part first. Then press Play and listen. Choose the best answer (A, B or C) for each question.

parts.title: Part 1 · Where is Teddy?
parts.intro: You will hear Mai talking to her dad.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Dad, I can't find Teddy!

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: When did you last see him?

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: This morning. I had him in the car. I think I left him there.

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: I looked in the car, and he isn't there. Was he in your school bag?

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: No, I took him out at the park. Maybe he's on the bench.

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: Then let's go to the park. What does he look like?

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: He's brown, with a small red scarf.

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: Don't cry, Mai. We'll find him. Put on your coat, and I'll get the car keys.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Thanks, Dad. I really hope he's safe and warm.

parts.title: Part 2 · At the park
parts.intro: You will hear Mai talking to the park keeper, Mr Lee.

script.speaker: Mr Lee
script.text: Hello, young lady. Can I help you?

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: I lost my teddy bear. I think I left him in the park.

script.speaker: Mr Lee
script.text: Hmm. Someone found a bear near the swings this morning. Is he brown?

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Yes! And he has a red scarf.

script.speaker: Mr Lee
script.text: Then I think it's him. A boy gave him to me. I put him in a box in my office.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Thank you so much! He is my best friend.

script.speaker: Mr Lee
script.text: You're welcome. Please say thank you to the boy. His name is Jack.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: I'll write a card for him tonight and bring it here tomorrow.

script.speaker: Mr Lee
script.text: He'll love that. Now take your bear and go home before it gets dark.

parts.title: Part 3 · The next day
parts.intro: You will hear Mai talking to her friend Nam.

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: Did you find Teddy?

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Yes! A boy found him by the swings, and the park keeper looked after him.

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: That's lucky! Were you sad?

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Very sad. I cried a little at the park. But now I'm happy. I made a card for Jack.

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: What did you draw on it?

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: A picture of the park with a big sun.

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: Nice. Maybe you should put Teddy's name inside his scarf.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Good idea. I'll ask Mum to sew it tonight.
